summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE or LOUISIANA.

Motion to dismiss.
attorneys: Mr. .Miles Taylor and Mr. P. Phillips for plaintiff in error., Mr. Thomas J. Durant and Mr. Charles W. Hornor for defendants in error. _

opinions.author: Waite
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Waite

delivered the opinion of the court.

The writ of error taken in this cause is dismissed, because it does not appear that judgment of the state court necessarily involved the decision of any question which could give this court jurisdiction. Dismissed.
